evidence.source: Academia Sinica, 漢字構形資料庫
evidence.text: The character page lists oracle-bone, bronze (including inscription 集成04178), Chu manuscript, and small-seal forms. Its explanation identifies two 又 (hand) forms as semantic elements and says that in small seal they were arranged vertically. This is the database’s interpretation; the page does not establish that a cooperative scene was the historically intended meaning.
evidence.title: 漢字「友」：字形演變

evidence.source: Chinese University of Hong Kong, 漢語多功能字庫
evidence.field: 形義通解; 甲骨、金文、簡帛字例; 《說文》; 《廣韻》
evidence.text: The entry interprets the early graph as two hands facing the same way, sometimes joined, suggesting friendliness, and explicitly says 又 also acts as a phonetic. It reports oracle-bone uses as a personal name and as 侑 in a sacrificial context; bronze examples use 友 for friend/friendly relations and associates or officials. It also reports Mawangdui Laozi A 友弱勝強 corresponding to B 柔弱勝強. The page gives no absolute dates for these individual witnesses. Its dictionary sense list does not establish a continuous semantic chain.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：友

evidence.text: The exact file description identifies 友-seal.svg as a modern vector depicting 友 in Shuowen seal-script style. The file page labels the representation public domain and says attribution is not required, though appreciated. It is an illustration of a script form, not an image of an ancient artifact.
evidence.title: File:友-seal.svg — Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The Commons description page for the exact 友-seal.svg title was found through search and its indexed contents inspected; a direct open returned a cache-miss error. Exact MediaWiki imageinfo API requests for 友-seal.svg, 又-seal.svg, and Shuowen Seal Radical 076.svg were inaccessible through the web tool. Search results verified the 友 seal file’s description and license, but did not verify metadata for the two 又-related file leads.

search_audit.outcome: Search surfaced indexed Commons pages for 友-seal.svg and related character files, including descriptions and a license statement for 友-seal.svg. It did not verify the exact 又-seal.svg or Shuowen Seal Radical 076.svg metadata.

gaps: The direct Commons page and API requests for exact image metadata were not accessible. Search-indexed page contents did verify the 友-seal.svg description and public-domain claim, but no visual inspection of the file pixels was performed.
The provided 又-seal.svg and Shuowen Seal Radical 076.svg leads lack verified exact-file descriptions, original file URLs, and license metadata in this run; do not treat them as approved image assets.

The available sources differ in emphasis: Academia Sinica describes the repeated 又 forms as semantic hands, while CUHK also assigns 又 a phonetic role. The precise role of each repeated shape remains unresolved.

The early personal-name and sacrificial 侑 contexts, bronze friend/associate uses, and Mawangdui 友-for-柔 spelling are reported by CUHK without absolute witness dates on the page; their chronological or semantic links are not established.
